3 /-! The graph on original vertices, with adjacency certified by an entire shared edge. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
6 
7 /-- Graph vertices are exactly the genuine vertices specified in the public definition. -/
8 abbrev Vertex (P : ConvexPolyhedron) := (P.vertices : Set Space)
9 
10 /-- Two original vertices are adjacent when their segment is a whole shared facet edge. -/
11 def edgeGraph (P : ConvexPolyhedron) : SimpleGraph P.Vertex where
12   Adj a b := a ≠ b ∧ ∃ F G : P.Face,
13     P.ShareEdge F G ∧ F.val ∩ G.val = segment ℝ (a : Space) (b : Space)
14   symm := by
15     intro a b ⟨distinct, F, G, shared, edge_eq⟩
16     exact ⟨distinct.symm, F, G, shared,
17       edge_eq.trans (segment_symm ℝ (a : Space) (b : Space))⟩
18   loopless := ⟨fun _ h => h.1 rfl⟩
19 
20 noncomputable instance edgeGraph_locallyFinite (P : ConvexPolyhedron) : P.edgeGraph.LocallyFinite :=
21   fun _ => Fintype.ofFinite _
22 
23 noncomputable instance edgeGraph_compl_locallyFinite (P : ConvexPolyhedron) :
24     P.edgeGraphᶜ.LocallyFinite := fun _ => Fintype.ofFinite _
25 
26 /-- The zero normal touches every vertex, so cannot have just two contact vertices. -/
27 theorem normal_ne_zero_of_contact_pair (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : P.Vertex)
28     (distinct : a ≠ b) (n : Space)
29     (contacts : (P.contactVertices n a : Set Space) = {(a : Space), (b : Space)}) :
30     n ≠ 0 := by
31   intro zero
32   subst n
33   have all_vertices : P.contactVertices 0 a = P.vertices := by simp [contactVertices]
34   rw [all_vertices] at contacts
35   have distinct_points : (a : Space) ≠ (b : Space) := fun equal => distinct (Subtype.ext equal)
36   have two : P.vertices.card = 2 := by
37     have count := congrArg Set.ncard contacts
38     simpa [Set.ncard_pair distinct_points] using count
39   have lower := P.four_le_vertex_count
40   omega
41 
42 /-- A supporting plane whose contact vertices are exactly a and b certifies their original edge. -/
43 theorem edgeGraph_adj_of_contact_pair (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : P.Vertex)
44     (distinct : a ≠ b) (n : Space) (nonzero : n ≠ 0) (support : P.SupportsAt n a)
45     (contacts : (P.contactVertices n a : Set Space) = {(a : Space), (b : Space)}) :
46     P.edgeGraph.Adj a b := by
47   have distinct_points : (a : Space) ≠ (b : Space) := fun equal => distinct (Subtype.ext equal)
48   have dimension : affineDimension (P.contactVertices n a : Set Space) = 1 := by
49     rw [contacts]
50     exact affineDimension_pair distinct_points
51   obtain ⟨F, G, shared, edge_eq⟩ := P.exists_facets_of_one_dimensional_contact
52     n a nonzero support (P.vertices_subset_body a.property) dimension
53   refine ⟨distinct, F, G, shared, ?_⟩
54   rw [edge_eq, P.contactSet_eq_convexHull n a support (P.vertices_subset_body a.property),
55     contacts, convexHull_pair]
56 
57 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
